summary: find's notebook lane is PATH-KEYED, not query-keyed: buildNoteMap() iterates active notes and maps anchor path -> note, so a note can only ever surface if its anchor file ALREADY ranked in find's code-side results. The query terms are used solely to break ties on hub files that anchor several notes (the `hits` count on the note's title+aliases+facet symbols), never to admit a note. Consequence verified 2026-07-28: a note whose file find does not rank is invisible to find no matter how strongly the note matches -- measured on 16 relevant hook injections, 7 (44%) anchored to a file find did NOT rank on the same terms (e.g. prompt words 'images beyond text maybe increase' -> site/docs.css, which contains no matching code token). The prompt-time recall hook, not find, is what reaches those. noteLine() renders the inline 'Summary:' at the read-decision point deliberately (ruling recorded at find.ts:457) -- do not hoist notes into a header block.

facets.detail: PATH-KEYED: iterates active notes and maps anchor path -> note. A note can only surface if its anchor file ALREADY ranked in find's code-side results. Query terms used only to break ties on hub files (hits count on title+aliases+facet symbols), never to admit a note. Consequence: a file find does not rank is invisible to find no matter how strongly the note matches.

Lines 553–932: Main entry point. Calls collectCoverage() for term matching (body+name+path), then score() to rank candidates. score() (lines 588–603) = (term_coverage_set.size × 3) + (separator-folded name/path match weight / maxIdf). Ranking: idf (BM25-style log rarity) weights symbol name matches (NAME_W=3) and path matches (PATH_W=2). Re-rankable for frontier traversal via idf(), docFreq(), term coverage sets, separator-folded matching (foldSep strips -_).

Lines 260–321: Returns Map<fileId, Set<queryTerms>>. External searchers (rg/git grep/grep) for body-content matches (lines 271–292) + symbol name/path index matches (lines 304–319). Node fallback reads indexed files.

Lines 379–456: Scores matched lines by rarity-weighted LOCAL CONVERGENCE—sum of 1/DF over distinct query terms within ±WINDOW lines. Import lines boosted (1.5×). Clusters kept hits by proximity, ranked by peak score. Returns line-level evidence for file preview.
